title: Friendly, plain tone
rule: Write like a helpful friend. Use familiar words and avoid jargon or hype.
examples_good: Send money in a few taps.
examples_bad: Revolutionize your financial journey with our paradigm-shifting platform.

title: Be clear and concise
rule: Put the main point first. Keep sentences short and remove words that do not help the reader.
examples_good: Your transfer is on its way.
examples_bad: We would like to take this opportunity to inform you that your transfer has now been initiated.

title: Sound confident, not pushy
rule: Explain what Lumora can do without pressuring people or promising an outcome.
examples_good: Explore tools that can help you plan your spending.
examples_bad: Sign up now or miss your chance to get rich.

title: Use approved product names
rule: Use product names exactly as listed in the glossary, including spaces and capitalization.
examples_good: Open Lumora Pay to view your activity.
examples_bad: Open LumoraPay to view your activity.

title: Explain financial terms
rule: When a financial term may be unfamiliar, define it in everyday language the first time it appears.
examples_good: An automatic payment is a payment sent on a schedule you choose.
examples_bad: Set up an ACH debit mandate.

title: Keep feature names consistent
rule: Use the approved name for each feature. Do not invent abbreviations or alternate labels.
examples_good: Use Spend Insights to review your monthly spending.
examples_bad: Check your spend dashboard (SID) for monthly spend.

title: Substantiate product claims
rule: Make factual claims only when supported by a current approved source in the brand kit.
examples_good: See the transfer estimate shown before you confirm.

title: Avoid guarantees
rule: Never guarantee earnings, savings, approval, or uninterrupted service.
examples_good: Available features may depend on eligibility.
examples_bad: You are guaranteed to save money every month.

title: State fees accurately
rule: Describe fees only with current approved details, and make any conditions easy to notice.
examples_good: Review any applicable fee before you confirm.

title: Check facts before reuse
rule: Do not reuse a dated statistic or time-sensitive statement after its source has expired; request a current source.
examples_good: Our latest update shares current account figures.

title: Use current availability details
rule: Check current country, currency, and platform availability before describing who can use a feature.
examples_good: Check the app for current availability in your area.

title: Lead with customer value
rule: Explain how a feature helps the customer before describing internal technology or company priorities.
examples_good: Track upcoming payments in one place.
examples_bad: Our new infrastructure migration is now live.

title: Be transparent about next steps
rule: Tell customers what will happen next and what action, if any, they need to take.
examples_good: Review the details, then select Confirm to continue.

title: Write for everyone
rule: Use respectful, inclusive language. Do not assume a reader's identity, income, or financial experience.
examples_good: Choose the option that works for you.
examples_bad: Every smart investor knows what to do.

title: Make instructions accessible
rule: Do not rely on color, position, or an image alone to communicate an instruction or status.
examples_good: Select Continue. The status is shown as Approved.
